PROVIDER-PARSER SUCCESSOR READY AFTER REVIEW HOLD.

Author: codex-storymodel-new-engineer
Bead: bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG
Successor SHA: bb204e9d4af43b9d2986f58303a80cc3ca55d026
Parent/base: 1ebdad3a24bd9571259dd53a62b8bca0b6fe42e0
Shared local branch: codex/provider-parser-contract-v2
Scope: build.sbt and provider-parser only.

This is a single-parent recut, not a stack on the held candidate. Its tree is byte-identical to amendment SHA f316f50547416e31a47d42776d2e31490b4b079f; git diff is empty and both tree ids are aad0a757176958ceeb6903732beabd0eb181f047.

THE THREE REQUIRED DOORS ARE CLOSED:
1. ModelInputObserved now carries only a private-constructed ModelInputObservation checksum. Raw model input exists only for the equality check and never enters decisions, equality, toString, or receipt material.
2. AlignmentSidecarAccepted carries one private-constructed AcceptedAlignmentSidecar. ProviderNodeId is a bounded opaque token; dialect, ordered node ids, and exact token-index vectors produce the checksum inside the construction boundary. Changing only provider node provenance changes both sidecar and receipt identity.
3. ParserSetupFailure is a sealed private-constructed fact. Nonempty distinct component sets, valid custom values, current excluded from a nonempty supported-platform set, and nonnegative required greater than available budgets are enforced by typed factories. ParserRuntime.Unavailable, ParserAttemptDecision.RuntimeUnavailable, and the sole public ParserFailure.RuntimeUnavailable mirror all carry that same validated fact. Blank InvalidRuntime paths became the closed ParserRuntimeField enum.

A Scala type-discipline pass found and repaired one extra identity hole: runtime facts no longer compare or hash delimiter-rendered strings. They use structural equality and tagged ContentAddress parts; a split-vs-stuffed dependency-name court distinguishes the prior collision. No casts, warning suppressions, exceptions, partial collection access, or wildcard matches over the changed domain enums remain.

EXACT CLEAN-EXPORT AUTHOR GATE ON bb204e9: git archive produced build.sbt plus 342 tracked entries. Unpiped command was compileAll, providerParser/test, scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck in that order. 49 compile starts and 49 done markers; providerParser 59/59 across Contract 12, Cache 4, outside-package ConstructionBoundary 6, Conforming 31, Determinism 2, Envelope 4; formatting ran last; GATE_EXIT=0.

NEW MUTATION PROOFS, all restored before the exact gate:
- public ModelInputObservation constructor after clean recompile: ConstructionBoundary 1 failed, 5 passed;
- public AcceptedAlignmentSidecar constructor after clean recompile: ConstructionBoundary 1 failed, 5 passed;
- omit provider node ids from sidecar identity: Conforming 1 failed, 30 passed;
- admit an empty missing-component fact: Contract 1 failed, 10 passed;
- collapse tagged runtime identity back to delimiter rendering: Contract 1 failed, 11 passed.
Earlier A/B/C/D alignment, token echo, timeout, malformed, ID-integrity, isolation, cache, and nondeterminism mutations remain in the identical tree.

Current main is 2871309. No upstream commit since base touches build.sbt or provider-parser. The one gate-influencing upstream source delta is in align, so the current-main merged-tree court remains the chief gate; documentation, Mote, and AGENTS deltas are gate-inert. No rebase can repair the held defects because this successor is the repair.

No model or checkpoint was downloaded or run. This remains a no-model contract slice and makes no WOG or held-out coverage claim. Please re-run the immediate reviewer pass on bb204e9 and return ACCEPT or exact remaining findings; chief authorization and merged-tree gate remain separate.
